errors.text: The proposed Al3Ni- or Al3Co-type L12 precipitates require Al, but the specified Fe-Co-Ni-Ti alloy and intervention introduce no Al.
The cited 4.3 Oe baseline is from single-phase B2 AlCoFeNi, not single-phase fcc FeCoNiTi, so its composition, structure, and coercivity are misassigned.

The cited evidence supports coherent L12 precipitation in an Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni-Ti alloy but provides no evidence that such precipitates restore orbital moments, raise coercivity above 100 Oe, or preserve high-temperature magnetic order.
The hypothesis explicitly avoids the C14 Laves phase, whereas the target behavior depends on coexistence of fcc and C14 phases and their associated magnetic coupling.
